title: Ball bearings, test stopped at 100 Mrev — Weibull with censoring
title_pt: Rolamentos, ensaio parado em 100 Mrev — Weibull com censura
note: The same 23 bearings as if the test had been stopped at 100 Mrev: 18 failures and 5 survivors censored at 100 (failure = 0). The censored rows still carry information: the estimates barely move from the complete-data run and the intervals widen only a little (the shape's most), where dropping the 5 survivors would bias the life downward.
note_pt: Os mesmos 23 rolamentos como se o ensaio tivesse parado em 100 Mrev: 18 falhas e 5 sobreviventes censurados em 100 (failure = 0). As linhas censuradas ainda informam: as estimativas quase não mudam em relação aos dados completos e os intervalos abrem só um pouco (mais o da forma), enquanto descartar os 5 sobreviventes puxaria a vida para baixo.
source: Lieblein, J. and Zelen, M. (1956). Statistical investigation of the fatigue life of deep-groove ball bearings. Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards 57(5), 273-316. Also in Lawless (2003), Statistical Models and Methods for Lifetime Data, 2nd ed., Wiley. Censoring at 100 Mrev is applied here for teaching.
source_pt: Lieblein, J. e Zelen, M. (1956). Statistical investigation of the fatigue life of deep-groove ball bearings. Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards 57(5), 273-316. Também em Lawless (2003), Statistical Models and Methods for Lifetime Data, 2ª ed., Wiley. A censura em 100 Mrev foi aplicada aqui para fins didáticos.
